_annotation.what: Individual promotion with title, subtitle, original price, discounted price, validity date, image, CTA, and feature list.
_annotation.why: A single promotional offer with clear savings (Gs. 70,000 off), defined validity, and visible features removes hesitation and drives immediate booking.
_annotation.ai_popolates: Title and subtitle: Generated from your offer description. Original/discounted price: AI calculates savings percentage. Validity: Set from your stated promotion period. Feature list: AI extracts key inclusions from your service catalog.
_annotation.your_input: Tell us your offer (service package, discount %, validity dates). We generate the full promo card.
